form.title: 28% Rate Gain Worksheet—Line 18

lines.caption: Enter the total of all collectibles gain or (loss) from items you reported on Form 8949, Part II

Enter as a positive number the amount of any section 1202 exclusion you reported in column (g) of Form 8949, Part II, with code “Q” in column (f), that is 50% of the gain, plus 2/3 of any section 1202 exclusion you reported at 60%, plus 1/3 of any section 1202 exclusion you reported at 75%
Enter the total of all collectibles gain or (loss) from Form 4684, line 4 (only if Form 6781, line 1 is more than zero); Form 6252; Form 6781, Part II; and Form 8824
Enter the total of any collectibles gain reported to you on Form 1099-DIV, box 2d; Form 2439, box 1d; and Schedule K-1 from a partnership, S corporation, estate, or trust
Enter your long-term capital loss carryovers from Schedule D, line 14; and Schedule K-1 (Form 1041), box 11, code D
If Schedule D, line 7, is a (loss), enter that (loss) here. Otherwise, enter -0-
Combine lines 1 through 6. If zero or less, enter -0-. If more than zero, also enter this amount on Schedule D, line 18

form.notes: A WORKSHEET, NOT A FILED FORM. It re-characterises part of a gain already counted in Schedule D's net so that part can be taxed at up to 28% instead of the ordinary long-term rates. Its result reaches Schedule D LINE 18, which is NOT part of line 16 — it changes the TAX, never the NET. Captions are transcribed from the Instructions for Schedule D (Form 1040) (2025); line 5's code reference is quoted as printed.
